notes.title: Multiple Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1.Blink (teleport) no longer causes the player to fall below the floor

2.Fixed an issue where the second boss did not cast skills in phase 3

3.Starting a new game from the main menu after loading a save no longer affects player data

4.Defeating a boss and immediately starting a new game from the main menu no longer grants a new Soul Shard

notes.title: 2025/8/2 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Gamepads can now properly use the Blink (teleport) ability.

notes.notes: [p]The bug where the final boss defeat did not trigger the ending screen has been fixed.[/p]

notes.notes: [p]The bug that prevented reviving using the gamepad has been fixed.[/p][p]Players can now enjoy the game without worries.[/p]
